stories.headline: Correction: Steam Link on Vision Pro streams flat games only
stories.subtitle: Valve's Vision Pro app is a TestFlight beta for 2D Steam games in a resizable window — not PC VR, and not Half-Life: Alyx in VR, per Valve's own announcement and an Oct. 23 correction. Don't let customers buy a Vision Pro expecting a PC VR headset.

stories.headline: Horizon OS v2.9 rolls out: spatial windows, QR scanner, wider Meta AI
stories.subtitle: Quest 3, 3S, Pro, and Quest 2 get a new window manager for up to three side-by-side windows, a built-in QR scanner, and Meta AI in the UK, Australia, Japan, Mexico, South Korea, and Singapore. Rollout is gradual, so some headsets will wait days.

stories.headline: Valve may be working on an OLED Steam Frame, codenamed 'Plano'
stories.subtitle: Code hints at a refreshed Frame with 3,552×3,840 OLED displays per eye and foveated upscaling on the same Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 chip. Unconfirmed — plus SteamOS 0.4 already boosts battery life up to 12% and adds CAD files for accessories.

stories.headline: OpenXR ratifies cross-platform spatial multitasking API
stories.subtitle: The Khronos Group published new OpenXR extensions bringing Apple-style spatial multitasking to Quest, Steam Frame, Android XR, and XREAL glasses. Implementations roll out through 2026 — a quiet win for headset apps acting like real computers.

stories.headline: XREAL Aura priced at $1,279 — about $20 under Meta's VR Glasses
stories.subtitle: XREAL put a number on its long-teased Aura glasses: $1,279 base, roughly $20 less than Meta's $1,299.99 VR Glasses. The head-to-head for spring wearable VR is getting real, and customers comparing the two will cite this.
